 Milan face major injury crisis ahead of Udinese clash 
 MILAN, ITALY - SEPTEMBER 16: Mario Gila of AC Milan in action during the UEFA Europa League 2026/27 League Phase MD1 match between AC Milan and SL Benfica at Stadio San Siro on September 16, 2026 in Milan, Italy. (Photo by Marco Luzzani/Getty Images) 
 October 24, 2026 
 1 
 With the Rossonerri set to face Udinese tomorrow evening at the Bluenergy Stadium, Milan coach Ruben Amorim has found himself in a difficult predicament ahead of a vital fixture as three prominent players are all deemed unavailable.
 La Gazzetta dello Sport reports that Mario Gila, Diego Moreira, and Adrien Rabiot are all held at bay due to injuries for the fixture in Udine, and concerns regarding their availability for the Milan Derby against Inter next weekend have also been raised.
 For the Spanish defender, the diagnosis indicates that he underwent an overload inflammation in his left ankle. As per the French central midfielder, he suffered right calf fatigue. Moreover, the former Strasbourg winger endured left hamstring fatigue. 
 An immense feeling of unease is brewing as the Rossonerri find themselves with a very thin squad heading into a pivotal part of the season, as they seek to bounce back from their irritating 3-0 defeat to Premier League outfits Bournemouth to maintain on course within the race for Champions League football next season.
 With Matteo Gabbia, Alexis Saelamaekers, and Sameuele Chukwueze already on the treatment table due to long-term injuries, it remains to be seen which players will be called up to the trip to face the Zebrette tomorrow evening, as the former Manchester United coach will undoubtedly have no choice but to turn to the Milan Futuro team for reinforcements given that his squad has been reduced to nearly skin and bones
 As it stands, it seems that Amorim will line up his squad with a 4-3-3 formation against Udinese. Englishman Fikayo Tomori is the most likely candidate to take the spot of the former Lazio defender. In addition, Ardon Jashari is expected to slot in midfield to fill the void of the veteran Frenchman, and rising star Alphadjo Cisse should be deployed out wide in the position of the Belgian international on the left flank.
 Julian Faustini – GIFN
